en.headline: Hong Kong waste paper to be fully pulped locally from 1 October
en.dek: The Environmental Protection Department said the Tuen Mun EcoPark facility can now handle all local recovered paper, ending reliance on export and expanding accepted types to include mixed paper.
body: The Environmental Protection Department said recovered waste paper in Hong Kong will be fully processed into pulp locally from 1 October, after the modern pulping facility at Tuen Mun EcoPark ramped up capacity since its commissioning in July.

A department spokesman said the plant’s capacity is sufficient for all of Hong Kong’s recovered paper and can raise annual throughput from more than 500,000 tonnes to 720,000 tonnes. Types accepted will expand beyond traditional cardboard, newspapers and office paper to include other mixed paper such as paper bags, packaging boxes and wrapping paper that meet quality standards.

The spokesman said the shift moves the local recycling chain from simple collection and export to local resource recovery, supporting the circular economy. The service contract sets a designated minimum purchase price so frontline collectors continue to receive a floor price for clean, uncontaminated paper. The facility recorded a single-day peak of 1,608 tonnes this month.

zh.headline: 回收廢紙下月起全面本地製漿 毋須再靠出口
zh.dek: 環保署表示屯門環保園紙漿設施已提升處理量，10月1日起本港回收廢紙將全面本地製漿，並擴大至雜紙類別。
body: 環境保護署表示，屯門環保園現代化紙漿生產設施於今年7月啟用後逐步提升處理量，本港回收廢紙將於10月1日起實現全面本地製漿，毋須再依賴出口。
發言人指，設施處理能力足以消化全港廢紙，年處理量可由逾50萬公噸逐步提升至72萬公噸。回收種類亦由傳統紙皮、報紙及辦公室用紙，擴至符合質量標準的雜紙，包括紙袋、包裝盒及包裝紙。
發言人說，本地廢紙回收鏈正由簡單收集模式轉型為本地資源化，推動循環經濟。合約設有指定最低價，確保前線收集者以不低於該價收購合標準廢紙。設施本月更創下單日最高收紙量1608公噸的紀錄。
